duration: About 3 months (2026: June 23 to Sept 22), about 5 to 7 hours a week, hybrid
name: PV Events Fellowship
what_you_do: Lead the planning of Girlvolution, a youth arts and social justice event, with training, a mentor and a $5,000 event budget. Also help run 3 other community events.
who_can_apply: BIPOC girls and gender expansive youth ages 16 to 19 who live or go to school in or near Seattle and King County.
deadline_text: Applications closed for 2026. The page says to check back next year. 2027 dates not posted.
notes: Powerful Voices also lists other paid teen internships on its For Young People page (Activistas for ages 14 to 19, Artivism, DYVAS). Those pages do not post pay or dates, so they are not listed separately.
